items.title: Mixed discrete and continuous distribution limits for shape parameters of pure quartic number fields
items.author: Sudipa Das; Sushant Kala; Arunabha Mukhopadhyay; Anwesh Ray
items.difficulty_reason: The complete shape-parameter limit requires exact integral-basis/Gram-matrix descriptions across residue/sign types,discriminant ordering,rectangular lattice-volume estimates and a squarefree/coprime sieve with type-dependent local factors and a discrete parameter. Old180732 only provides the TypeIGram calculation750–819; the full distribution/sieve argument and mixed continuous/discrete limit are additional nonroutine content. OriginalX^(1/3)normalization,Mstar,rstar,rectangle bounds and native measure definitions retained without harmonization or strengthening to a Haar/probability equidistribution statement. Five types/sign cases one counted theorem; shape-injectivity and other supporting statements not separate counts.

primary.label: Complete original rectangle-count distribution limit,normalization,local factors and all type/sign cases as one theorem

proof_spans.label: Complete original field-shape/integral-basis context and author lattice-point/squarefree-sieve distribution proofs

contexts.label: Original shape space,pure-quartic sign/residue types,matrices,parameters and measure definitions
